Scrye magazine oversized sticker of [[Boba Fett]], with the Cloud City expansion-set banner. Still at 0:55 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical magazine sticker on [[Oversized and undersized cards|Oversized cards]]. Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 The CCG Collector] (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].
